topic: Caño Cristales river of five colours
hook: Your river in Colombia turns red, yellow, green and blue.
title: The River Of Five Colours Is Real
description:
Caño Cristales in Colombia is nicknamed the river of five colours. In the right season its bed glows red, with yellow, green and blue around it. The red comes from a plant that grows on the riverbed.

#Shorts #Geography #Places
